means: The bottom bucket of the same score axis as 'best quality' - the training-set label for the images nobody rated well.
does: In the POSITIVE it is self-sabotage: soft, muddy, badly drawn output, which is exactly what it labelled. In the NEGATIVE it is one of the most reliable tags available on this checkpoint, because pushing away from a score-axis pole is a well-formed request in a way that most negative content tags are not - there is a clean gradient to move along. It sits in this project standing negative, always beside 'lowres'.
reach_for_it: never in the positive. Keep it in the standing negative on every anime render, with 'best quality' in the positive so the same scalar is pushed from both ends.
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
